TokenMeter v0.2.6 adds GPT-6.1 Sol pricing to the general and Codex catalogs.

- Use $2 input / $0.10 cache read / $2.50 cache write / $10 output per million tokens for prompts up to 272K input tokens.
- Apply $4 / $0.20 / $5 / $15 to the full request above 272K input tokens, and 2× API rates for Codex Fast/Priority.
- Preserve all existing model rates and historical price segments. Previously unrecognized GPT-6.1 Sol usage is recalculated at its own rates when local cost caches rebuild.

Prices were verified on October 2, 2026 against [OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing) and the [GPT-6.1 Sol model documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol).

Requires macOS 13 or later; the universal archive supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
